import zipfile, shutil, os, re, subprocess, time, signal
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/user/Desktop/Dolch_Sight_Words_Primer.docx')
# close LibreOffice so the file can be safely edited
subprocess.run(['pkill','-f','soffice'], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(1)
bak=p.with_suffix('.docx.bak')
if not bak.exists(): shutil.copy2(p,bak)
ns='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'r') as zin:
    files={n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
root=ET.fromstring(files['word/document.xml'])
ET.register_namespace('w','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main')
vowels=set('aeiouAEIOU')
for r in root.iter(ns+'r'):
    texts=list(r.iter(ns+'t'))
    if not texts: continue
    s=''.join(t.text or '' for t in texts).strip()
    m=re.match(r'[A-Za-z]', s)
    if not m: continue
    color='FF0000' if m.group(0) in vowels else '0000FF'
    rPr=r.find(ns+'rPr')
    if rPr is None:
        rPr=ET.Element(ns+'rPr'); r.insert(0,rPr)
    for old in list(rPr.findall(ns+'color')): rPr.remove(old)
    c=ET.Element(ns+'color'); c.set(ns+'val', color); rPr.append(c)
files['word/document.xml']=ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n,d in files.items(): zout.writestr(n,d)
subprocess.Popen(['libreoffice', str(p)])
PY
", interval=0.001)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
